product_metadata.title: Ivation Family Size 3.4 QT/3.2L Electric Air Fryer Oven 1400W - Healthy Low-Fat AirFryer with Little to No Oil - Digital Timer and Temperature Control with 7 Cooking Presets Menu - Black
features: Revolutionary Air Technology Offers Healthier Frying with Tablespoon of Oil or Less
Intuitive Controls Make it Easy to Set Temperatures up to 392° for Variety of Foods
Innovative Air Circulation System Evenly Distributes Heat; Auto-Shuts When Ready
Features 7 Convenient Presets: Warm-Up, Chips, Chicken, Steak, Meat, Cake, Fish
Includes Removable Pan & Detachable Basket; Both Clean Quickly in Dishwasher
description: You’re minutes away from healthy, grease-free food.

The revolutionary technology of the Ivation Air Fryer uses a powerful convection fan to circulate hot air which rapidly cooks the food to perfection. Simply follow the clear instructions, press a few buttons, and within minutes you will be enjoying delicious healthy food without the oil and grease.
Several popular food presets are included.

In the box you’ll find suggested settings for numerous popular food items. From fries to meats to poultry to snacks to baked goods, there is a lot to love about what this air fryer can do. Now you can serve the entire family with minimal effort or preparation.

Set the exact cooking time and temperature for any food you want to prepare – at the touch of a button. With 1400W of cooking power, the Ivation Air Fyer is remarkably effective at keeping steady temperatures throughout the entire cooking process.
Smart Air Circulation for Even Heating

Utilizing an effective rapid air circulation pattern, this air fryer evenly distributes the hot air around the food. With every pass, the food is gradually brought closer to the final temperature. This results in a perfect cook level without charring.

For some foods, a little shake at the halfway-ready point achieves a crispier result. The frying pan therefore slides out from the rest of the unit, and the 3.3L ‘Teflon’ basket is also detachable from the pan for easy dispensing of ready food.

Once the cooking process is started, you can let the air fryer work on its own – no need to monitor it or adjust the heat. It features double overheating protection circuits, a timer that can be set up to 60 minutes, and when the food is ready, the fryer shuts off automatically and emits an audible alert.
